identity_anchors: stylized letter 'K' composed of thick rounded strokes
disconnected upper-right diagonal stroke of the 'K'
four-pointed star/sparkle symbol at the top right
must_preserve: The specific geometric structure of the letter 'K' (vertical bar, lower diagonal, detached upper diagonal)
The rounded terminals/caps of the 'K' strokes
The four-pointed star shape and its relative position to the 'K'
The high contrast between the white logo mark and the dark background
can_restyle: Background gradient hue and saturation (as long as it remains dark enough for contrast)
Material/texture of the 'K' (e.g., neon, metallic, matte, glass)
Glow effects or shadows around the 'K' and star
The specific color of the star (can shift within cool tones or match theme accent)
Corner radius of the overall icon container
must_not_replace_with: Standard serif or sans-serif typography without the specific disconnected stroke design
color_preservation: The deep purple is a strong brand identifier but can be shifted to analogous dark tones (indigo, violet) or desaturated for dark modes. The white 'K' should remain light/high-contrast. The star's blue-purple gradient can be adapted to the theme's accent color but must remain distinct from the main 'K' color.
structure_summary: A minimalist, geometric monogram of the letter 'K' with rounded ends and a deliberately detached upper-right arm, accompanied by a magical four-pointed sparkle in the upper right quadrant, set against a solid or subtly graded dark field.
risk_notes: Reconnecting the upper-right stroke of the 'K' will destroy the specific brand geometry.
Changing the 'K' to a standard font will lose the custom identity.
Removing the star makes the icon look like a generic initial.
Using a light background without adjusting the 'K' color will ruin visibility.
